non_goals: This run does not add new mathematics: all theorems were already proved on their own branches. It only re-executes them on dev's machine and pins the sources, binary and outputs.
The two negative controls are captured in a separate REJECT run; they import their positive counterparts and therefore cannot be compiled in the same Lean invocation.
scope: CG-007 W9 branch coverage: the 16 positive Lean-core formal sources left on GPT branches origin/dev-02, origin/dev-03 and origin/dev-04, compiled on this machine with the pinned Lean 4.34.1 binary inside a network-denied sandbox, so that every GPT-branch formal package now has a dev-visible receipt. Each source is byte-identical to its branch original.
status_vocabulary_note: KERNEL_REJECTED is the repository-wide status word for 'the proof checker rejected the target'. rejection_stage says which Lean stage refused it.
